'''HN Group Wiki''' is the encyclopedia of [[HN Group]] and its companies, written and maintained by HN Group staff. It covers the [[List of HN Group companies|companies in the group]], their [[Horizon Network#Services|services]] and their brands.

{{Columns start}}
{{Box start|From today's featured article|purple}}
[[File:hn-group-wordmark.svg|thumb|The HN Group wordmark]]
'''[[HN Group]]''' brings together [[Horizon Network]], [[Horizon Media Group]] and [[Horizon Assets Management]]. [[Horizon Development]] brings software expertise to Horizon Network, and [[Horizon Advertising]], a Horizon Media Group company, is managed by Horizon Network alongside its digital infrastructure. The businesses share people, systems and standards across the group, so a client of one Horizon business can draw on the skills of all of them. ('''[[HN Group|Full article…]]''')
{{Box end}}

{{Box start|Did you know…|teal}}
* … that the stripe under the [[HN Group#Brand|HN Group wordmark]] is made of '''eight colours''' arranged in steps?
* … that [[Horizon Advertising]] is a subsidiary of [[Horizon Media Group]], but is managed by [[Horizon Network]]?
* … that Horizon Hosting, [[Horizon Network]]'s planned hosting service, will offer VPS, dedicated servers and managed cloud?
* … that Horizon Network can also be reached at '''horizonetwork.com''', with '''horizon-network.co.uk''' as its main address?
* … that [[Horizon Assets Management]] owns the group's domains, Discord servers and technical assets, but has no staff of its own?
* … that [[Horizon Advertising]]'s roundel logo is lavender, while the other Horizon roundels are indigo?
{{Box end}}
